description:
Seal an agent output as an Outcome Receipt (ORC v0.1) and register its
    commitment. Returns a portable receipt anyone can verify offline (L1) and
    against this notary's registry (L2). The notary attests integrity and
    time ("notarized"), not correctness. No floats in output; stores only
    digests. Spec: docs/standards/OUTCOME_RECEIPT_v0.1.md

bindings.description: Optional. Ids to bind into the receipt, for example an escrow id.
bindings.title: Bindings

excludes.description: Optional. Field paths to leave out of the digest, for example timestamps.
excludes.title: Excludes

output.description: The agent output to seal, as an object.
output.title: Output

profile.description: Optional. Receipt profile name. Default generic.
profile.title: Profile

subject.description: Optional. What the output is about: {agent, tool, ...}.
subject.title: Subject

name: seal_outcome_receipt
title: Seal outcome receipt
